title: Project Haris: Maritime M-SOC Validation Dataset (NMEA 0183/2000 snapshots and raw capture, 2026-08-03 .. 2026-08-17)
description: Flattened Elasticsearch snapshot exports and raw captures backing the validation work of the Project Haris open-source maritime security operations center (M-SOC). Two edge nodes: bench (NMEA 0183 simulator) and vessel (NMEA 2000 / CAN). Includes the full raw CAN capture of the vessel NMEA 2000 bus (36,238,192 frames, 76 unique PGNs).
notes: Coordinates are full-precision as collected (research-vessel telemetry). Per-file coverage windows: bench.csv Aug 3-17; vessel.csv Aug 3-13 (vessel bus live Aug 3, 5-7, 10-13); combined.csv Aug 3-17; raw/nmea_raw_bench.log Aug 3-12; raw/can0_raw_sinilind.log Aug 5-13 (vessel node offline Aug 14-23). Vessel Aug 3 rows are empty snapshots (bus not yet live).
